notes: GiVo Server 1.0 (build 57) for macOS, Windows and Linux/Docker. Refreshes Stalker portals end to end (guide and VOD) and holds the provider session for all your devices; deeper portal guides through the provider's bulk guide endpoint; about one-seventh of the memory on large portal guides; live refresh progress and honest status; recordings on channels served only as HLS; overlapping recordings merged into one stream with both entries kept; VOD pages and search for Xtream playlists.
